hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight

rules: Never center align body text; left-align for editorial readability.
Use Playfair Display for all major headings to establish the newspaper authority vibe.
Use IBM Plex Mono for UI elements like tags, AI analysis scores, timers, and small labels to give a telegraphic, objective feel.
Avoid cliché red and blue for political sides. Use stark Black vs Bone-White split layouts to represent opposing views.
Use 'accent_ai' (Chartreuse) for anything driven by the AI (match percentage, topic generation, AI analysis).
Borders should be solid black or solid white depending on the background. Do not use soft gray borders.

textures: Use newspaper collage/noise textures at low opacity (e.g., 5%) over backgrounds to remove digital flatness.
shapes: Sharp edges. Use `rounded-none` or max `rounded-sm` for all UI elements, cards, and buttons. No soft pills.
Solid 1px or 2px borders around containers to mimic editorial column dividers.
shadows: Hard shadows (neo-brutalist) instead of soft diffused shadows. Example: `shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)]`.

layouts.landing_page: 50/50 Split Motif. Left half dark background, right half light background. Text spans across or is inverted on each side.
layouts.dashboard: Editorial newspaper grid. Multi-column masonry or strict CSS Grid with visible 1px borders between columns and rows (`border-collapse` style).
layouts.video_chat: Side-by-side equal weight rectangles for video feeds. A stark monospace timer in the center. Text chat in a rigid sidebar.
layouts.spacing: Generous. Use `p-8` to `p-16` for main sections. Inside dense dashboard widgets, use tight `p-4` with visible dividers.

components.buttons: Square or rectangular. Hard borders. Hover state inverses the colors (e.g., black bg with white text becomes white bg with black text).
components.cards: Cardless design or flat rectangles with 1px solid borders. No rounded corners.
components.inputs: Flat bottom border only (`border-b-2 border-black bg-transparent`) for free-text onboarding, giving a 'fill-in-the-blank' typewriter feel.
components.tags: Small rectangular badges, monospace font, solid background.

motion.hover: Instant or very fast transitions (0.15s). No slow fades. Emphasizes the brutalist, responsive nature.
motion.loading: Rapidly cycling text (like a printing press or ticker tape) for 'Finding a Match' instead of standard spinners.

accessibility.contrast: Extremely high contrast by default (Black on Bone White).
accessibility.focus: Thick 2px outline using the AI accent color (#D6FF00) for focus states.

landing_hero.description: Serious grayscale portrait of a woman, for the dark/left side of the split screen.

landing_hero_2.description: Serious portrait of a man, for the light/right side of the split screen.

debate_section.description: Two people having an intense discussion, to be used in the 'How it works' section.

texture_overlay.description: Newspaper typography texture. Use as a low-opacity background mix-blend layer.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the app in React using Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI primitives.
Override all Shadcn UI default rounded corners. Set `radius` to `0` in Tailwind config or manually apply `rounded-none`.
Implement a 50/50 vertical split layout on the Landing Page. One side is `bg-[#0A0A0A] text-[#F4F4F0]`, the other is `bg-[#F4F4F0] text-[#0A0A0A]`.
For the 'Find a Match' queue screen, do not use a circular spinner. Use a text-based animation (like a marquee or fast-scrolling monospace text 'ANALYZING STANCE...', 'SEARCHING OPPOSITION...').
Use standard HTML5 `<video>` elements with placeholder sources or empty dark rectangles for the WebRTC chat room UI preview.
Ensure the dashboard uses visible borders on grid items to mimic a newspaper layout.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics.
No emojis for icons. Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide React with sharp, serious weights.
Every interaction needs a micro-animation, but for this brutalist theme, keep them fast and sharp (not bouncy).
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical. Use padding heavily inside bordered containers.
Do not apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
Do not center align the app container in global CSS.
Use `data-testid` attributes on all interactive elements.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Typography is a design element. Scale headings massively (`text-6xl+`) to create impact.
Use negative space purposefully. A blank screen with just a massive headline and a start button is better than a cluttered dashboard.
When placing text over the newspaper texture or images, ensure contrast ratios by using solid background blocks behind the text.
The AI (Gemini 3.1 Pro) analysis output should be visually distinct (using the Chartreuse accent and Monospace font) from the human user input (which should be Serif or Sans-serif).
